Our Work

Built to Prove a Point

Most projects we ship are under NDA. Radioller is our open proof-of-work — a full-featured internet radio app, live on four app stores.

Radioller

radioller.com

50,000+ stations. One codebase. Five platforms.

A production internet radio app, live on four app stores and as a PWA on the web. Built in C# from end to end — .NET MAUI on mobile and desktop, Blazor on the web.

Available on:
Google Play App Store Mac App Store Microsoft Store Web
💻

One Codebase, Five Platforms

Mobile and desktop apps run on .NET MAUI &mdash; native performance on Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows from a single codebase. The web version is a PWA, sharing the same C# business logic across all five platforms.

📱

Adaptive for Every Screen

Compact layout on phones, split-panel on tablets, resizable panes on desktop. Smooth reflow between portrait and landscape without losing playback.

🌐

7 Languages, No Restart

Switch interface language inside the app with immediate effect. English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, and Ukrainian — all built in.

🎧

Deep OS Integration

Lock screen controls, AirPods, car stereos, Bluetooth headsets &mdash; every media button handled. Audio focus and ducking follow platform conventions exactly.

🌗

Dark Mode & Live Theming

Full dark and light mode with automatic system detection, switchable at runtime without restarting. Every colour, icon, and background updates instantly in one pass.

📡

50,000+ Stations, Offline

The full catalogue is bundled locally &mdash; search and browse without internet. Filter by country, genre, or language. Only the stream needs a connection.

50,000+ Radio stations
7 Interface languages
5 Platforms, one codebase
